criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Six of nine frames are the wafer and boat motif, and they are competent. Slide 6 is the best frame, and its counts read at 432 px without the labels. Slide 5 has the boldest value structure. Three frames fall short of THE SHOWSTOPPER TEST. Slide 8 puts a stock laptop with a generic UI behind the wafer boat on a warm wood desk, a default prop, and about 17 wafers there mean nothing; the right-hand discs thin out into floating ellipses. Slide 7 is two flat copper torn-paper shapes with crumbs on grooved black slats. Slide 2 is a stucco tile grid with heavy mid-tone texture, and machine QA warns of busy art under the label. Slides 1, 3 and 4 put dark brown wafers on a dark bench with no bright edge; slide 4 is the muddiest. Slide 9's plate reads more like a form UI than a lit object: cast_fraction 0.136, the left rail runs on below the plate frame, and the rivet shadows end in hard cuts.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: A real spine: one wafer stands for $1M across slides 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6, and the boat's end condition changes state. The value track holds dark. Slide 2 is grey stone tiles, slide 7 copper on black slats, and slide 8 a wood desk with a laptop. The wafer material drifts from brown-black on 1, 3, 4 and 8 to steel-blue on 5.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces to a primary Texas Tech Now page. Hedges are kept. One stretch: 'a cluster not built yet' (c4) is inferred from 'will help Texas Tech establish'. The governor's TSIF listing was not fetched, so c18 rests on the university's restatement. No hard fail found.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where and which body are clear. Nothing is given for what a Texan can do or watch for, and the close is a rhetorical question.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe. Slides 3 to 6 build to the turn on 6, and slide 9's empty recess lands. Slide 2 is a context pause. Slides 7 and 8 are a detour, and 8 repeats the wafer boat with no encoding.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register. 'Lubbock, by way of the governor's office' is a good line. 'Drawn to illustrate' recurs on seven of nine slides. 'The cluster is servers working as one system' is flat. Little West Texas specificity.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Floodlit interior and relief against nos. 74 to 76, which were lastLight exteriors. The opening move is a familiar docket framing.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild slides 8 and 7 on the same black lab bench and wafer carrier as the rest of the deck, and give the dark-brown wafers on 1, 3 and 4 the single bright raking edge slide 5 has.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A stock laptop on a warm wood desk behind an unencoded run of wafers; a third material world.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Delete the laptop and the desk. Model one wafer lying flat on the black bench, cut into a lit die grid, with a hard side key so each die casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Two flat copper torn-paper shapes and crumbs on grooved black slats; reads as a sticker.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Replace it with a single wafer on the bench whose surface steps up in three or four raised epitaxial terraces, raked from the left.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stucco tile grid in the grey middle with busy texture under a black-on-copper label.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the stucco displacement to a fine matte grain, sink the surrounding county tiles to near black, and light only the raised Lubbock tile from a low side.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Two boats of near-black wafers on a dark-grey floor with no bright edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Move the key light behind and to the left of the boats so every wafer top catches a lit arc, and darken the floor to true black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Reads like a form UI; the left rail extends below the plate frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the key to a raking angle so the recess walls and rivets cast long shadows, and trim the left rail to end at the plate's lower border.
